t: This is St Mellitus College, a theological college set up in 2007 by the Dioceses of London and Chelmsford of the Church of England. It has campuses in Earl's Court, Chelmsford, Plymouth and Nottingham. The college is wholly non-residential, and it has pioneered training based in real ministry settings, combining academic study with placements throughout the course. Richard Chartres, the retired Bishop of London, founded it.
